description: This file defines the MysqliManager class, a PHP class that extends MysqlManager to implement MySQL database management using the mysqli extension. It provides methods for executing queries, handling database connections, retrieving metadata, and managing mysqli-specific operations within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: MysqliManager
classes.description: A PHP class that implements MySQL database management using the mysqli extension, including connection handling, query execution, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, handling different input types and logging performance details.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a result set.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and performs cleanup.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of field names from a result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from a result set as an associative array.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in SQL queries.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database using configuration options.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Retrieves informational metadata about the MySQL connection.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the mysqli extension and configuration allow for driver usage.

methods.name: compareVarDefs
methods.description: Compares two variable definitions, with special handling for MySQL version differences.
